title: Local Library
emptyDesc: No documents yet. Give AI your teaching materials.
removeConfirm: AI will stop citing it. Restorable from trash within 30 days. The file itself is kept.
trashNotice: Trashed files still count toward quota and are purged after {{days}} days.
dropHint: Click to choose files, or drop them here
errExt: Unsupported format (md / txt / docx / pdf only)
inTrash: Same content is in trash; restore it first
testPh: Ask a real question and inspect the recall
rebuildWarn: All vectors will be cleared and rebuilt. Search uses keywords meanwhile; cloud embeddings will be billed again.
purgeConfirm: This permanently deletes “{{name}}” and all chunks. Type the document name to confirm.
folderDeleteConfirm: Documents inside move to Uncategorized. No files are deleted.
folderNamePh: Folder name, e.g. Exams / Textbooks / Lesson plans
disabledHint: Enable it in System Settings → AI → Knowledge Base (cloud + local library).
batchRemoveConfirm: Selected documents move to trash; original files are kept.
localChannelHint: Local vector channel is not ready: Ollama is not running or {model} is not pulled. Only cloud vectors are available. Start Ollama (enable launch at login), run ollama pull {model}, then use Maintenance → Rebuild vector index.
duplicateNamed: Already in the library as "{{name}}" — identical content cannot be added twice
tooManyFiles: Up to {{n}} files per batch; extras were not queued
trashMine: Showing only documents you removed; admins see the full school trash
refillConfirm: Re-embed only ready documents whose vectors are missing or failed. Originals are not re-parsed and the keyword index is untouched; the cloud channel incurs minor embedding cost. Continue?
vecGapAlert: {{n}} ready documents have no vectors yet; semantic recall is off (keyword search still works)
modeTip: AI retrieval chain priority: cloud knowledge base → local library → direct LLM
statChunksSub: Up to {{n}} chars injected per query
